question: Which rGO content gave the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst its highest 4-nitrophenol reduction rate constant, and what volume of rGO solution was added in the synthesis to reach that content?
rendered: The rGO content that gave the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst its highest 4-nitrophenol reduction rate constant was 0.5 wt%. According to the document, to reach this content, 1 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and 1 mmol AgNO3 were dissolved and mixed thoroughly in 50 mL DI water, followed by the addition of 2 mL of rGO solution.
